title: How Murky Before a VLM Knows It Cannot See? Accuracy, Confidence and Abstention on a Physical Visibility Axis
abstract: arXiv:2610.22981v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robustness studies of vision-language models (VLMs) grade degradation on nominal severity scales ("level 1-5") that carry no physical units, and they rarely ask whether a model's confidence follows the loss of visibility. We measure accuracy, internal (token-probability) confidence, verbalized confidence and an explicit abstain option on a visibility axis in metres: fog follows the Koschmieder model, an underwater arm scales the absorption spectrum of pure water, both are applied with a monocular metric depth map, and the visibility range V is swept over eight log-spaced levels from 250 m to 1.95 m. On 1000 COCO scenes and five small open VLMs (2-5 B parameters), accuracy on a boxed-object identification task falls from near its clean value to chance within a narrow band (half-way visibility V_acc of 12.1-15.9 m in fog and 20.5-38.6 m under water) while, for the four models that are confident on clean images, the confidence stays high:

translated_title: 视线要有多浑浊，视觉语言模型才知道自己看不见？——基于物理可视性轴的准确率、置信度与弃权研究
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的鲁棒性研究通常采用不携带物理单位的标称严重程度等级（“1-5级”）来衡量性能退化，并且很少追问模型的置信度是否随可见性的丧失而同步变化。我们在以米为单位的物理可视性轴上测量准确率、内部（token概率）置信度、口头表达置信度以及显式弃权选项：雾遵循Koschmieder模型建模，水下场景则按纯水吸收光谱进行缩放，两者均借助单目度量深度图施加，可视性范围V在250米至1.95米之间的八个对数间隔级别上扫描。在1000个COCO场景和五个小型开源VLM（2-5B参数）上，框选物体识别任务的准确率在很窄的区间内从接近干净图像的水平骤降至随机水平（雾中的半途可视性V_acc为12.1-15.9米，水下为20.5-38.6米）；然而，对于在干净图像上表现出较高置信度的四个模型，其置信度始终维持在高位：
tldr: 该研究首次在以米为单位的物理可视性轴上（基于Koschmieder雾模型和水下吸收光谱）系统测量视觉语言模型的准确率、置信度与弃权行为，发现当能见度降至十几米时模型准确率已骤降至随机水平，而其置信度却始终保持高位，揭示了VLM在“看不清”时缺乏自知之明的过度自信问题。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a physically grounded visibility axis measured in meters—using the Koschmieder fog model and underwater absorption scaling—to systematically evaluate VLM accuracy, confidence, and abstention, revealing that while accuracy collapses to chance within a narrow visibility band (12–39 m), model confidence remains stubbornly high, exposing severe overconfidence when VLMs can no longer truly see.
